name: Questionnaire
description: A short flow of questions asked one at a time, for onboarding or for an assistant that needs a few details. It shows progress, keeps answers when going back, and ends with a review step where each answer can be edited.

questions.description: The questions, in order. Plain data: { id, type, title, description?, options?, required? }. Type is single, multiple, text or scale.

onSubmit.description: Called from the review step with the answers keyed by question id. Single choice and text give a string, multiple choice an array of values, scale a number.

onCancel.description: Shows a Cancel button and is called when it is pressed.

allowSkip.description: Shows a Skip button on questions that are not required.

submitLabel.description: Text of the final button on the review step.

isSubmitting.description: The answers are being sent. Disables the buttons on the review step.

keyboard: Tab moves through the options and buttons; Arrow keys move between choices in a single choice or scale question
Space selects an option; Enter in a text answer moves to the next question
Back, Next, Skip, Cancel and Edit are buttons
requirements: Each question heading takes focus when the step changes
The step change is announced politely: Question 2 of 5
Progress is a progressbar with a value, plus the visible text Question 2 of 5
A required question that is empty shows an error, marks the field invalid and moves focus to the error
Answers are kept when going back
The review step lists every answer with an Edit button that names the question
screenReader: The heading of each question is read when focus moves to it
The progress is announced as Question n of total
A missing answer is announced as an alert

use_when: An assistant that needs clarifying answers before it goes on
Any flow where one question at a time reduces effort
avoid_when: Long surveys with branching logic: build a dedicated flow
anti_patterns: Clearing answers when the reader goes back
